integrity.independence_statement: No independent scientific validation has been performed.
integrity.mathematical_certificate: A strictly monotone scalar threshold proof plus an exact rational four-state transition certificate.
integrity.verification: Reproducible Python standard-library exact arithmetic and nonproof diagnostics are supplied.

scientific_limitations: A single Glauber spin-flip update is studied on a two-spin ferromagnet with a symmetric positive external field.
Local neighborhood-passivity failure does not refute the conjectured upper bound on discrete jump activity.
Publication priority against the full body of finite-state order-inversion literature is not guaranteed.
title: A sharp two-spin boundary for failure of neighborhood passivity under Glauber annealing
